title: marrubium velutinum subsp. cylleneum
intro: Marrubium velutinum subsp. cylleneum, commonly known as Cretan horehound, is a subspecies of perennial herbaceous plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Cretan horehound include its ability to act as a carminative, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, helping to relieve digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and ease respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Cretan horehound include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its ability to relax the smooth muscles and reduce spasms.
